items.summary: harness:check on Windows loses the tail of a criterion's stdout: RG-smoke output stops at test 52 of 74 even on exit 0, so a failure's Playwright detail and summary never reach last-check-output.json
items.detail: Both harness:check runs (exit 1 and exit 0) stored RG-smoke stdout ending at 'ok 52 … sheet.spec.ts:10:1'; the same command run directly with output redirected to a file prints all 74 lines plus the summary. The failure signature then hashes stderr line 1 ('[WebServer] $ concurrently …'), which does not describe the failure. Suspected cause: async pipe writes not flushed before the child exits under src/sandbox.js executeInSandbox.
